subject: Request: Approve standby capacity hold for XtraData pilot (A100/H100 mix)
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@xtradata.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@xtradata.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — rough numbers and ask for standby

Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had an internal sync and want to move to a two-week pilot in March. High-level compute needs: steady-state concurrency ~35 ASYNC sessions (sequence lengths ~1k tokens), and two big bursts for nightly batch scoring (~1M tokens each) over a 2-hour window. We expect to use an LLM similar to LlamaX-65B — quantized to int8 for throughput.

Can Redwood provision a short standby reserve while we finalize procurement? We'd like to hold the approximate mix below for the pilot window (Mar 8–21):
- 6x A100 80GB (for low-latency interactive nodes)
- 4x H100 (for heavy batching and throughput)

We understand standby incurs minimal fees — please send the sizing calc and the terms you need to lock this in. Also flag any blackouts if a higher-priority customer would require those GPUs.

Emily
Head of AI Platform
XtraData

--
Attachment: pilot_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Emily Zhang <emily@xtradata.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, carlos@xtradata.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — rough numbers and ask for standby

Emily — thanks for the clear numbers. Looping in Marcus and Dylan on capacity planning and procurement impact.

Quick notes while we run the calc:
- We can hold a standby pool for a 2-week window, but terms differ if the hold is refundable vs. committed.
- For your profile (latency + two heavy batch windows) we recommend keeping the A100s pinned to interactive queues with a 4-GPU-per-host layout (N pods per host) to preserve latency SLOs; batching should be routed to H100 cluster with larger micro-batches.

I'm attaching a small workbook with our inverse-cost equations and an initial capacity plan. Marcus / Dylan — can you validate the availability for Mar 8–21 and confirm whether putting a soft hold (no charge until activation) is feasible? If procurement needs a written statement for their PO, we can produce an occupancy letter.

Olga Petrov
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: xd_capacity_calc.xlsx
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — rough numbers and ask for standby

Olga / team — taking this on. Quick internal availability check after scanning the farm and upcoming reservations:

Inventory snapshot (as of 2027-02-19):
- Free A100 80GB hosts: 14 (each host = 8 GPUs) — not all contiguous; usable as 12 dedicated GPUs for low-latency queue after overhead.
- Free H100 80GB nodes: 6 hosts (each host = 8 GPUs) — capacity for large batch jobs but we have scheduled infra maintenance Mar 10–11 in one rack, reducing contiguous throughput briefly.

Proposal to support XtraData pilot (Mar 8–21):
1) Place a soft standby hold on 6x A100 and 4x H100. Soft hold = write reservation in our capacity planner but not bill until activation. This gives them exclusivity barring critical escalations.
2) Add a canary window the first 12 hours of activation to validate routing and KV cache warmup; if fail, we rollback without billing.
3) For compute placement, allocate A100s as 2 hosts (4 GPUs reserved per host) to maintain NVLink locality; H100s on two separate batch racks to spread thermal load.

Constraints / asks:
- We need procurement confirmation (email OK) by EOD Mon 2027-02-22 to convert soft hold to guaranteed reservation; otherwise holds will be auto-released per policy.
- Mar 10–11 maintenance could impact large-batch throughput; recommend shifting heavy scoring to Mar 12 night if possible.

I'll open a capacity ticket and attach the occupancy letter for the PO.

Marcus Lin
Fleet Capacity PM
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: standby_terms_v1.pdf (pdf, 45KB)
From: Emily Zhang <emily@xtradata.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos@xtradata.ai>, ops@xtradata.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 14:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — rough numbers and ask for standby

Olga / Marcus — thanks, that plan sounds fair and matches our SRE playbook. Two quick confirmations: behavior if maintenance hits the canary window (do we get an extended activation window?), and whether the soft hold can be converted to a partial billing hold (50% of standby fee) if we need extra runway while legal finalizes terms.

We can confirm PO intent by Monday EOD. If Redwood can produce the occupancy letter and a short clause for the PO about maintenance exceptions, we can push to procurement immediately.

Also cc'ing Carlos (ops) who will check internal timeline for shifting the heavy batch off Mar 10.

Best,
Emily
